### 8–16s — CN05-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · PURPOSE — What must continue?. Separate object care, digital preservation, research, public access, teaching, grants, commercial licensing, authentication, publication, and correction into explicit functions.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN05-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · ASSET — What would each steward receive?. Inventory title, custody, copyright, marks, contracts, data, restrictions, donor terms, cultural authority, liabilities, funding, and operational dependencies.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN05-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · GOVERN — Who decides and who can challenge?. Design board or leadership composition, expertise, conflicts, terms, removal, founder and community voice, worker or contributor input, research independence, appeals, and review.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN05-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · FUND — Can care survive attention cycles?. Model conservation, storage, digitization, staffing, insurance, systems, access, education, rights clearance, and contingency costs without assuming sales or donations will cover them.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
